name: Tsitsernakaberd Genocide Memorial
observe: From the memorial's upper approach the city lies behind you, Ararat ahead, and a sunken flame below — the site is laid out so the body descends before it can look back out.

name: St. Stephen's Cathedral
observe: The west front is older than the tower behind it.

name: Aboriginal Tent Embassy
observe: A beach umbrella planted on this lawn in 1972 became the first Aboriginal Tent Embassy, and the camp is still here.

name: the nestinari fire-walking rite
observe: Barefoot dancers trample glowing embers into ash while holding icons to their chests.

name: Mercado Municipal de São Paulo
observe: 72 stained glass windows line the upper walls of a 1933 market hall, depicting Brazilian agriculture above the stalls selling exactly those products below.

name: Taktsang (Tiger's Nest)
observe: A monastery hangs from a cliff face across the river, as if glued to the rock.

name: Sedlec Ossuary
observe: Every bone in the human body hangs in the chandelier.

name: Berliner Mauer — Bernauer Strasse
observe: Front doors opened east. Escape windows opened west.

name: Barcelona — Sagrada Família, nave light
observe: Gaudi designed the columns to branch. Above the branching point, the vault reads as a forest canopy.

name: London — Crossrail Place Roof Garden
observe: A dock district forest growing above a 30-meter station box.

name: Old Tbilisi
observe: Sulfur steam still reaches the lane before the bathhouse domes do.

name: Sermeq Kujalleg
observe: A glacier at the head of the fjord calves icebergs that drift past the town and out into Baffin Bay.

name: Varvakeios Central Market and Evripidou Street
observe: Under a 19th-century roof, Aegean fish lies on ice while butchers' stalls close in around it on three sides.

name: Kawah Ijen Sulfur Porter Path
observe: This trail is memorable not for the crater view but for steps worn hollow by decades of sulfur loads.

name: Roman Forum
observe: The burned patch in the Basilica Aemilia floor is still there.

name: Shibuya Crossing
observe: 3,000 people cross. None of them collide.

name: Jagalchi Fish Market Quay
observe: Busan's harbor enters the city here as wet floors, tanks, shouting counters, and fish still moving.

name: Budva Old City
observe: The masonry fell in 1979. They numbered each stone and put it back.

name: Avenue of the Baobabs Road Verge
observe: A working dirt road runs straight through the line of baobab trunks, and carts and motorbikes still pass beneath them.

name: Upper Gate
observe: A medieval gate that was closed during plagues, cutting off movement between the lower town and the varosh.

name: Amsterdam — Westerkerk Carillon Timing
observe: Anne Frank listened to these bells for two years from 50 meters away.

name: Warmiwañusqua (Dead Woman's Pass)
observe: On the Inca Trail, the first high pass tops out at almost 14,000 feet, and the body feels the number before the eyes confirm it.

name: Gdańsk Shipyard Gate No. 2
observe: Gate No. 2 — where the 21 demands appeared.

name: Lisbon — Belém, Padrão dos Descobrimentos shadow
observe: The shadow of the monument tracks across the map of its own expansion.

name: House of Flowers
observe: Tito was buried here in 1980. Yugoslavia kept arriving after Yugoslavia ended.

name: Mayakovskaya Metro Station
observe: The station opened in 1938 with thirty-four mosaic panels of Soviet sky. In November 1941, that same ceiling looked down on people sheltering from the bombing.

name: Basilica Cistern
observe: 336 columns, two Medusa heads used as pedestals.

name: Edmund Pettus Bridge
observe: The arch is ordinary. The crossing is not.

name: Hazrati Imam Complex
observe: A Qur'anic manuscript older than almost every modern state in the region was kept on this plaza until 2025.

name: Huế Imperial Citadel Enclosure Sequence
observe: Each gate is narrower than the last.

name: Vienna Central Cemetery
observe: This cemetery is laid out like an outer district.

name: Wave Hill Walk-Off Site
observe: On this open ground, workers left a cattle station in 1966 and turned a wage strike into a land claim.

name: the old bridge (Mustafa Pasha bridge)
observe: Eighteen stone arches span a river that in spring runs high and fast enough to drag entire uprooted trees downstream.

name: Elevador Lacerda
observe: A 71-metre lift connects two cities that occupy the same coordinates but different economic registers — the ascent takes 30 seconds.

name: Old Town Astronomical Clock
observe: The mechanism clunks before the apostles appear on the hour.

name: Bebelplatz — Sunken Empty Library
observe: A library of 20,000 empty shelves sits under your feet.

name: Granada — Alhambra, Patio de los Leones
observe: 124 columns. No two are identical.

name: Metekhi Church Cliff
observe: The church floor ends at a twenty-meter drop.

name: Uummannaq harbor
observe: Open water surrounds the island on every side except the harbor, which alone has turned to ice.

name: Kotzia Square Excavation: the Acharnian Road
observe: Opposite Athens City Hall, an open pit shows an ancient road, its retaining walls and graves on both sides.

name: Pantheon — Oculus
observe: The 9-metre hole admits rain.

name: Dunn's River Limestone Steps
observe: Water keeps laying down new limestone here even as visitors climb the same 960 feet of steps.

name: Yanaka Cemetery and Neighbourhood
observe: The part of Tokyo the firebombs missed.

name: Koutoubia Mosque Minaret
observe: Two foundation lines still show where the first mosque faced wrong.

name: Virgin Mary Bolnichka and St Nicholas Bolnichki
observe: Two small interlinked churches at the Lower Gate by the lake once held travellers in quarantine before they entered the city.

name: Pino Suarez Metro Temple
observe: At Pino Suárez, a working metro station contains a round Mexica temple because Mexico City keeps building through older sacred ground rather than away from it.

name: Amsterdam — Nemo Science Museum Roof Terrace
observe: The building is a lid over a live road tunnel. The roof is a public terrace.

name: Te Puia Geothermal Boardwalk
observe: The ground itself vents, stains, hisses, and smells as part of ordinary settlement.

name: Llactapata ridge building
observe: From a large building on the ridge above Llactapata, the outline of Machu Picchu folds over the distant skyline.

name: Nowa Huta — Aleja Róż Axis
observe: The avenue was scaled to Moscow, not Kraków.

name: Lisbon — Estação do Oriente, vault geometry
observe: The columns branch until the vault reads as a forest.

name: Staro Sajmiste
observe: Belgrade built a trade fair here in 1937. By 1942 the same pavilions were part of a camp.

name: Mendeleevskaya Metro Station
observe: A stray dog lived in the metro passages for years. Someone stabbed him in 2001. There is a bronze statue now.

name: Yazılıkaya
observe: Water cut the corridors of this cliff, and the Hittites carved their gods into the walls it left behind.

name: Kosmonavtlar Station
observe: A Soviet shrine to space flight, opened in 1984, still looks down on passengers underground.

name: Reunification Palace Operations Bunker
observe: Never surrendered — the tank drove through.

name: Narrenturm
observe: A ring of cells, not a hospital block.

name: out-of-service airstrip at the army camp in Yongphula
observe: An abandoned runway above Kanglung ends where the mountain wall begins, and the fog that swallows it makes the far end disappear.

name: Viñales Mogote Valley Rim
observe: Cultivation sits inside limestone walls that never stop feeling separate from the fields.

name: Old Jewish Cemetery
observe: The ground rises because the cemetery had nowhere else to go.

name: Soviet War Memorial — Treptower Park
observe: Five thousand Soviet soldiers are buried under the lawn you walk across.

name: Toledo — Mezquita del Cristo de la Luz
observe: One small room keeps Muslim, Christian, and Roman Toledo stacked together.

name: London — Postman's Park Memorial
observe: 120 tiles planned. 53 completed. The rest are still blank.

name: Anchiskhati Basilica
observe: The ceiling is two meters above the congregation.

name: Uummannaq Mountain
observe: A pale, lobed heart of rock rises straight up behind the houses, too big to see whole.

name: Strefi Hill
observe: From this hill in Exarchia, Lycabettus stands right in front of you and the Acropolis rises beyond the rooftops.

name: Sangiran Riverbank Fossil Section
observe: More Homo erectus fossils here than anywhere else.

name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus
observe: Stone animals from separate zoological registers occupy successive tiers of the facade, each carved by a different workshop with no directive to match.

name: Orvieto — Pozzo di San Patrizio
observe: Descending and ascending never share a step.

name: Rose Hall Plantation Ridge
observe: From this ridge the great house keeps the whole plantation in view, because that was the point of siting it here.

name: Tsukiji Outer Market
observe: The wholesale market moved. The vendors who served it stayed.

name: Saadian Tombs
observe: A plastered wall hid royal graves here for 307 years.

name: Tsingy Needle Footbridge
observe: The route narrows onto footbridges and metal holds above limestone needles, forcing every step through the karst.

name: Lychnidos
observe: A third-century BC Greek inscription reading LYCHNEIDION HE POLIS is carved into stone in the town that was built on top of the older one.

name: Amsterdam — Hollandsche Schouwburg Memorial
observe: The facade is complete. The interior is open sky.

name: Mt Veronica (Wakay Willka)
observe: A perfect triangle of white rises above a patchwork of brown fields and thatched huts, each with its own small-holding.

name: Lisbon — Terreiro do Paço, earthquake memory
observe: The ground rests on wooden piles driven after the earthquake. They are still there.

name: Prospekt Mira Metro Station
observe: Harvest garlands above. Transfer corridor. Nothing below. Both from 1952.

name: Heraclia (Kapıkırı)
observe: Low walls around the goat pastures turn out to be cut stone from an ancient city, still holding animals and marking fields.

name: Sardarapat Memorial
observe: The memorial stands on an open plain where the lack of cover made the 1918 battle a desperate stand.

name: Imperial Crypt
observe: The dynasty descends room by room.

name: Eureka Stockade Memorial Park
observe: The stockade line is barely visible now, but the battle here in 1854 lasted only about fifteen minutes.

name: Theatro Amazonas
observe: An 1896 opera house built at peak rubber boom sits in the Amazon; when the boom collapsed, it became technically useless and the jungle closed in.

name: Shanghai Old City
observe: Renmin Road still curves along the exact line Shanghai's 1554 wall once stood on.

name: Charles Bridge — Original Statues
observe: One saint is polished by touch; the originals had to be rescued indoors.

name: Karl-Marx-Allee
observe: Workers built this boulevard, then struck here against the state.

name: Bilbao — Guggenheim, titanium skin movement
observe: The titanium changes the building's shape across a single afternoon.

name: London — Barbican Highwalk
observe: A second ground level above the city that stops at the estate boundary.

name: Mtatsminda Pantheon
observe: The graves are cut into the slope above Tbilisi.

name: North Star Bay
observe: A long spit of sand marked by a flat-topped hill curves into a peaceful inlet at 77 degrees north.

name: Sawahlunto Mine Shaft Entrance
observe: Chained convicts dug this coal mine by hand.

name: Howrah Bridge
observe: 2.6 million rivets hold the structure together; the deck vibrates when heavy trucks cross, and you feel it through the soles of your shoes.

name: Aventine Keyhole — Knights of Malta
observe: St. Peter's dome fits precisely in a keyhole.

name: El Badi Palace
observe: The empty basin still shows how much palace was taken away.
